mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.1% indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that suppress consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts (HOUST) above 1600 and retail sales (RSAFS) above 600,000 signal robust consumer spending and housing demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST > 1600 and RSAFS > 600000.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 280) combined with persistently low policy rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.1%) indicates inadequate monetary response to inflation, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation with low policy rates
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 280 and FEDFUNDS < 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) above 19,800 billion dollars indicates expanding economic activity that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 exceeds 19,800.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 (index 2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is below 100.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous employment growth (PAYEMS) above 149,000 thousand and unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% signal a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate hiring, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 149000 and UNRATE < 4.5.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) below 1600 signals residential construction contraction that reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1600.
